reason_for_change: Flying 2/3 Snow Specter with combat-damage choice: bounce a permanent the player controls or make that player discard.
commander_identity_rationale: Supports Crosis's combat-damage discard strategy and adds flexible tempo.
role_impact: Adds evasive threat/trigger and cuts the equipment package.
power_level_impact: Four-mana body is slower but independently useful and flexible.
oracle_rules_verification: Flying; combat damage chooses bounce of a permanent that player controls to its owner's hand, or discard. Bounce is tempo; damaged player chooses.

reason_for_change: Trades equipment/equip investment for an evasive body with its own discard-or-bounce trigger.
commander_identity_rationale: Keeps discard pressure and increases standalone evasion/threat density.
role_impact: Loses equipment trigger option but gains self-contained creature value.
power_level_impact: Higher mana cost; may revisit if equipment trigger density proves better in actual games.
oracle_rules_verification: Shroud gives equipped creature +1/+0 and a discard trigger on combat damage; equip {1}.
